description.content: Manage content views which define curated sets of repositories and packages available to hosts.
Retrieve a paginated list of content views for an organization. Content views define curated collections of repositories whose packages, errata, and other content are made available to hosts.

query.description: Set the current organization context for the request.
Scoped search query string to filter results. Supports field-based search syntax (e.g., "name ~ web*").
Sort field and direction (e.g., "name ASC" or "id DESC").
Page number for paginated results (starting at 1).
Number of results per page. Use "all" to retrieve all results without pagination.

info.name: Red Hat Satellite REST Content Views API

description.content:
The Red Hat Satellite REST API provides programmatic access to Red Hat Satellite server functionality including host management, content view management, subscription management, lifecycle environments, and provisioning. The API is built on the Foreman and Katello upstream projects and follows RESTful conventions with JSON request and response bodies.
